climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A DO in the northernmost corner of Murcia, surrounded by Jumilla, Almansa and Alicante, and traditionally known as the home of Monastrell in Spain. It sells 92 percent of its wine abroad, the highest share of any Spanish DO.
